The '''Statue Of Perfection''' is a piece of [[Furniture]] obtained by interacting with [[The Farm#Grandpa's Shrine|Grandpa's Shrine]] once all four candles are lit (see [[Grandpa#Grandpa's Ghost|Grandpa's Evaluation]]). It produces 2-8 [[Iridium Ore]] per day.

==Trivia==
*[[Crafting#Bombs|Bombs]] will blow up the Statue of Perfection, but another can be obtained by interacting with Grandpa's Shrine.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Removed exploit allowing up to 109 Statues Of Perfection to be obtained in [[Multiplayer]] by placing them into offline farmhands' chests of drawers.}}
{{History|1.6|Removed exploit allowing the player to get infinite Statues Of Perfection on the farm by using a tool on the Statue while having a full inventory, then interacting with Grandpa's Shrine before taking the "tooled" Statue(s) into inventory.}}
{{History|1.6.9|Removed ability to take Statue Of Perfection to [[Ginger Island]] to obtain a second statue.}}
